diagnosticControls.boundary: Only these preliminary rate-policy controls temporarily filtered the native playbackRate setter. The final 8 tests observe the real player and real media without filtering or replacing native methods, properties, clocks or events.

limitations: Isolated desktop Chromium/WebKit automation, not acceptance on an actual iPad Safari.
Native AAC decoders report different clip durations; measurements use each engine native duration.
Mute/background cases control snapshot inputs and call player.stop(), matching the useSpeech cancellation chain; this does not claim a real device background transition.
Native AAC final-frame clock rounding permits 20ms; this rejects the observed 176ms repeated-rate clock reversal.
Timing, actual AAC decoding and cancellation were checked; no manual listening review is claimed.
Temporary raw report paths may not persist. All eight primary native event traces are included in this repository audit.

The player is exercised through a temporary source fixture, not by clicking the production application speech hook. Its frozen source and served main bundle/media digests are recorded; the actual application tracing is covered separately.
